notes.title: 诡事其一珍珠剧院reset plan
notes.notes:
嗨，我是诡事其一珍珠剧院的作者Mimangqi
诡事其一珍珠剧院是我某一天突然萌生出来的一个想法，然后由对于游戏制作什么都不会的我，经历9个月一边学一边制作，最后制作出来的作品。
后续发售后有玩家反映优化很卡，但是由于其底层架构是购买的，经验不足的我无法对其进行详尽的优化，同时加上游戏内灯光的开销，高分辨率的纹理，部分购买的模型不合理的UV，总之还有很多，于是我决定推倒重来，利用最新的虚幻5.5重新制作，同时对游戏的剧情，解密谜题，部分流程做些许改动，重制版的制作将于2025年2月开始，完成日期待定，完成后将直接进行替换更新
最后感谢您的支持和购买

notes.title: 9.19 Playtest bug fixes
notes.notes:
In 9.19, a bug that occurred that affected the flow of the game has been fixed

BUGS RAISED DURING TESTING
1. Flashlight brightness modification
2. Ending B process fixed
3. Fixed the blurred characters caused by the low LOD of the safe

Finally, thank you very much to the playtesters for their efforts and questions
The game is currently in beta

notes.title: 9.10 Game test BUG fixes
notes.notes:
[b] The BUG that affected the flow of the game in the first test day of 9.10 has been fixed [/b]

[b] The BUG in the test [/b]
1. The new level loading interaction fails, preventing the next level from being advanced
Fixed and confirmed to be a problem with code values
2. Some map game functions have problems, such as unlocking and item interaction problems
Fixed and identified as numeric errors and item value conflicts
3. The game keys are not fully guided
Updated

[b] Finally, thank you very much, all the game testers for your efforts and questions [/b]
The game is currently in beta
